method: paired source-parent and REAL artificial-record-group fixed-bank bootstrap of complete frozen distribution-loss contrast

existing_evidence.group_origin: Known historical 50-record artificial blocks, not identified independent acquisitions
existing_evidence.base_conditional_support: All eight frozen TRAIN-Q bins used by all A/final hypotheses; original min16 row-count rule

primary_plan.source_draw: 512 draws with replacement from exactly 512 saved source parents
primary_plan.source_draw_pack: Retain all four saved paired responses per selected parent; no within-parent resampling
primary_plan.REAL_draw: 419 draws with replacement from the 419 groups represented in the REAL reference bank only
primary_plan.REAL_draw_pack: Retain every reference-bank row in each drawn group; do not draw group-internal rows
primary_plan.control: REAL_REAL point only; no control bootstrap and no union-of-422 group sampling
primary_plan.initial: Preserve initial point receipt; initial is not a primary comparator and needs no additional 500-replicate run
primary_plan.seeds: Root must preassign distinct uint64 source-plan and REAL-group-plan seeds before freeze; record full plans plus before/after RNG states
primary_plan.REAL_expanded_rows: Variable; save total and unique source parents/groups/rows each replicate
primary_plan.group_size_weighting: Preserve original event-weighted empirical distribution; do not average each group distribution equally
primary_plan.categorical_label_policy: Identifiers/groups enter resampling bookkeeping only; never waveform/NN inputs

frozen_statistic.S: mean of S_h across fixed fast/slow/common_level
frozen_statistic.primary_contrast: Delta_b = S_final_b - S_A_b; negative denotes lower proxy distance
frozen_statistic.primary_interval: Unadjusted 95% two-sided percentile interval, quantile probabilities .025 and .975, NumPy method linear, exactly all 500 paired replicates
frozen_statistic.relative_change: 100 * Delta_b / S_A_b for each replicate, guard finite positive denominator; point change uses point S_A
frozen_statistic.wave_definition: .50*mean six projected W1 terms + .25*mean voltage/shape coordinate W1 + .25*mean eight time-resolved short-lag W1 terms
frozen_statistic.qpsd_global: .50*(marginal standardized logQ/PSD W1 + projected standardized logQ/PSD W1)
frozen_statistic.qpsd_reduction: .50*(global_qpsd + mean supported conditional PSD W1 terms); original global-only fallback if no supported bins
frozen_statistic.bin_boundaries: Original FIT_STATISTICS008 TRAIN boundaries frozen; bucketize raw extended-log output Q, side left, separately for each saved view/hypothesis
frozen_statistic.standardization: Original fixed TRAIN centers/scales, q_reference, q_floor and peak_floor; no replicate refitting
frozen_statistic.observation: Already saved hard waveform_V; no redigitization, peak/crop recomputation, or new noise reconstruction

support_rule.count_basis: Expanded row multiplicity, not number of unique nonzero-weight rows and not original unexpanded array length
support_rule.fake_bin_count: sum_rows m_source[parent(row)] * I(saved output-Q bin == k)
support_rule.REAL_bin_count: sum_reference_rows m_REAL[group(row)] * I(saved output-Q bin == k)
support_rule.conditional_mass: Normalize each domain independently within the selected bin
support_rule.global_term: Always includes all rows/mass; no tail or low-charge event removal
support_rule.dynamic_fallback: Reproduce original supported-bin/fallback statistic exactly and store every coverage mask
support_rule.missing_bins: Keep each planned replicate and its exact metric/coverage diagnostics; never redraw, drop, impute, or select a common survivors-only subset
support_rule.decision_guard: If any primary replicate has incomplete conditional coverage, label coverage artifact and do not directly confirm stable benefit

secondary_plan.additionally_save: All six per-hypothesis component contrasts and their marginal intervals can be saved from the same already computed vectors
secondary_plan.interval_scope: Marginal descriptive 95% intervals, not simultaneous family coverage
secondary_plan.bootstrap_bias_diagnostic: Report mean Delta_b minus point Delta and percentile interval; do not choose percentile/basic/BCa after seeing outcomes
secondary_plan.zero_fraction: Optional descriptive fraction of Delta_b<0; never call it a p-value or posterior probability

implementation_risks.risk: Existing loss APIs accept fake weights only and conditional support counts unexpanded rows
implementation_risks.remedy: Literal source/group-expanded row arrays with original loss OR an exact dual-domain weighted-CDF implementation tested against literal expansion, including variable REAL N and unequal conditional counts

implementation_risks.risk: Fast equal-N sorted-difference path cannot be used for variable REAL totals or nonconstant bootstrap weights
implementation_risks.remedy: Exact integration of abs(CDF_fake-CDF_REAL) over merged sorted support; each domain and each conditional bin normalized separately
Sample complete source-parent packs, not 2048 independent generated rows

implementation_risks.risk: REAL row independence and control overlap
implementation_risks.remedy: Use 419 reference groups; only point RR uses disjoint control rows; group blocks are sensitivity units, not physical acquisitions

Use same original native CPU/runtime and registered evaluation seed; require native fingerprint if reproducible, otherwise retain distinct fingerprint plus <=1e-7 baseline component error gate and unchanged saved inputs
Count duplicate multiplicities exactly and preserve original fallback/coverage records, with no selective missing-replicate filtering
Cache fixed waveform transforms/projections and sorted support in float64; chunk feature/replicate tiles; no projection thinning, approximate quantiles, fewer bins, or reduced hypotheses
Use fixed final-versus-A contrast and predeclared thresholds only; no best checkpoint, scale, hypothesis, seed, or bootstrap budget selection

fixtures: Uniform baseline weights equal the existing 010 point loss
Literal expanded group weights equal exact-CDF loss with unequal REAL N
Tie supports and zero multiplicity rows
Conditional counts include multiplicities and min16 boundary cases
Duplicated source parent retains all four draws and all hypothesis pairing
Failure/partial replicate count preserved; no successful COMPLETE before 500 results
engineering_requirements.protected_SHA_inputs: Original 010 source manifest, policy, bank, A/final waveform NPZ and their parent IDs, original TRAIN data/stat/group identity binding, initial/final evaluation JSON; no original trained weight load required
engineering_requirements.baseline_gate: Reproduce all six A/final waveform/QPSD and subcomponent points against original 010 receipts within 1e-7 before bootstrapping
engineering_requirements.runtime: Root to freeze native CPU/thread/RSS/wall/output caps and batch sizes based on artificial full-shape engineering tests; no scientific pilot or budget extension
engineering_requirements.cache: Precompute point transforms/projected coordinates and exact sorted support; use bounded replicate/feature chunks; preserve all wave view/short-lag/QPSD terms
engineering_requirements.completion: Exact500 planned/attempted/completed with primary arrays, per-hyp/component arrays, plan and support diagnostics, native exit and final unchanged-input/source SHA proof

decision_rule_recommendation.worth_next_bounded_per_loss_crop_diagnos: All500 finite and engineering binding gates pass, every primary replicate uses complete original conditional coverage, and upper primary Delta percentile95% endpoint <0
decision_rule_recommendation.interpretation_of_yes: Stable sign under the registered fixed-TRAIN-bank source/REAL-group reweighting; only motivates the next registered mechanism diagnosis
decision_rule_recommendation.uncertain: If primary interval includes zero, no stable-benefit claim; preserve result and do not expand bootstrap/training or choose another CI scheme
decision_rule_recommendation.harmful_or_coverage: If direction is adverse or coverage/finite/gate checks fail, report the exact issue and do not confirm stable benefit
decision_rule_recommendation.secondary_CI_role: Diagnosis and tradeoff context only; no post hoc selection of a winning hypothesis or threshold
never_implied: Automatic GAN arm or more training

interpretation_limits: Conditional on fixed fitted A/final models, this selected TRAIN pool and the four saved draw packs, original preprocessing and frozen projection bank.
The bootstrap changes empirical row/group weights, not the response/noise model. It does not generate new latent/noise draws or refit training.
Source packs contain only four repeats. Their empirical conditional variation cannot represent all true conditional response uncertainty.
Original REAL50-record groups are artificial blocks in one historical acquisition, not established independent acquisitions; unknown cross-block/acquisition uncertainty remains.
010 trained on all of these TRAIN events and was chosen after 009 TRAIN diagnosis. Preregistering011 now does not remove adaptive model-design/in-sample selection optimism.
The chosen statistic has absolute values, sorting and support discontinuities. General percentile-bootstrap coverage is not automatically calibrated for this composite Wasserstein contrast.
With500 replicates each2.5% tail has only about12.5 resample ranks; report finite MonteCarlo resolution, and do not adaptively extend the budget.
No formal calibrated hypothesis test, posterior improvement probability, independent generalization, hardware acceptance or physical noise identification follows from an interval excluding0.

primary_method_references.title: Inference for Empirical Wasserstein Distances on Finite Spaces
primary_method_references.use: The authors discuss failure of the classical bootstrap for finite-space Wasserstein inference. This motivates an explicit non-calibrated stability interpretation; it is not a proof that this specific paired composite interval fails.

primary_method_references.title: ClusterBootstrap: hierarchical repeated-measure cluster bootstrap
primary_method_references.use: Preserve the full set of repeated measurements within each resampled cluster; do not treat repeated responses as independent parent events.

primary_method_references.title: SciPy bootstrap official documentation
primary_method_references.use: Paired resampling reuses an index plan across paired arrays, and percentile intervals come from resampled statistic quantiles. Independent SOURCE/REAL unit counts require separate domain plans.
